SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF APR-22-2009 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF APR-22-2009 BY JUDGE PRO TEM: MARK SCHREIBER. APPEARANCES BY BOTH PARTIES. EXHIBITS RETAINED. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506).
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF APR-22-2009 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF DURCANIN, SCOTT RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT SORRENTINO, NAJEEN BROKER FINNEGAN, JOHN BROKER/OWNER $750.00 PRINCIPAL, $50.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $800.00, THE DEFENDANTS, JOINTLY AND SEVERALLY, SHALL PAY THE PLAINTIFF. THE COURT FINDS THE FAIR MARKET VALUE OF THE GOODS FOR WHICH PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM IS MADE TO BE $750.00, REFLECTING A REDUCTION FROM THE ORIGINAL COST FOR DEPRECIATION. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, AS TO DEFENDANT SORRENTINO, NAJEEN BROKER FINNEGAN, JOHN BROKER/OWNER
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED JUL-01-2009 ORDERED DESTROYED
